observations: Account-token verification is a GET at the account-scoped tokens/verify resource under client/v4.
Successful response exposes status active, disabled or expired inside result.
Implementation requires success to be the boolean true and status exactly active; no token identifier or response body is emitted.

interpretationLimits: User-token verification HTTP401 alone does not establish token expiry or the type of the supplied token.
Neither verification success nor known-bucket read proves R2 write, Worker edit or deployment authority.
method: public official documentation only; no authenticated API request
